name: Bounded V30 frozen-candidate development outcome input

upstream_bounded_asset.relationship: CY-035 does not enlarge the CY-034 Stage-A authorization. It is a separate, runner-bound development-outcome arm over the same immutable physical compact and the exact frozen Stage-A cohort.

representation.use_in_stage_b: identity audit only; reselection is forbidden

lineage.snapshot_limitation: The compact retains row available_at/decision_at and industry_snapshot_id but omits the daily source snapshot_id. Use is therefore limited by exact physical, upstream-lineage, cohort, protocol and runner hashes.
lineage.coverage_limitation: 2013-2017 is a certified CY-006-schema chronology extension rather than globally registered CY-006; the physical 2018-plus extension is semantically certified but not hash-identical canonical CY-006.

authorization_boundary.allowed: Attach exactly one frozen +10-percent/H20/40-bps development lifecycle to each of the 2,312 immutable Stage-A event identities, preserving no-entry, invalid-lineage and incomplete outcomes.
authorization_boundary.blocked: Candidate reselection, representation changes, charts, portfolio replay, validation, grids, threshold changes, rows after 2020-12-31, live use and strict PIT-A claims.

execution_contract.entry: First later legal non-limit-up raw open in signal cal_idx +1 through +3, filled at coordinate open.
execution_contract.target: Before fallback eligibility, the first later same-lineage legal coordinate high at or above 1.10 times entry fills at the exact coordinate target only when finite positive raw high and raw down-limit prove the bar was not locked at the down limit.
execution_contract.fallback: On a row with cal_idx strictly greater than entry cal_idx +20, process the opening auction before any same-day high: a sellable coordinate open at or above target fills conservatively at the exact target; a sellable open below target exits immediately at coordinate open; only an unsellable open may defer to a later same-day legal target touch.
execution_contract.within_bar_chronology: The fallback-eligible open decision always precedes that day's high. No later intraday high may cancel a legal time-stop fill already available at the open.
execution_contract.limits_suspensions_and_actions: Binding; missing or changed required state fails closed and is never normalized or substituted.
execution_contract.unknown_action_state: A physically present entry-window or post-entry row with null corporate_action_count, corporate_action_valid or corporate_action_blocking invalidates the event immediately; it may not be skipped and later recovered.

scientific_boundary.claim: Outcome attachment measures the frozen mother population only; it is neither chart-rule validation nor a portfolio backtest.
scientific_boundary.next_step: Any chart rendering requires a new bounded authorization that binds the completed Stage-B artifacts and the frozen visual protocol.
